jobs.occupation: Head of Sales - Regulated B2B Services
jobs.description:
Our client is a well-established international service provider operating across multiple countries in Europe and beyond. With several hundred employees in Belgium and a strong position in its market, the company is currently entering a new phase of growth driven by innovation, strategic partnerships and evolving customer needs.

To support this development, our client is looking for a Head of Sales Belgium.

Jobomschrijving

Reporting directly to the Managing Director and sitting on the local leadership team, you will lead the commercial function, shape the sales strategy, develop key customer relationships and manage a team of experienced sales professionals.Commercial Strategy & Growth

• Define and execute the commercial strategy for the Belgian market.
• Translate business objectives into clear action plans and measurable KPIs.
• Identify growth opportunities and drive business development initiatives.
• Monitor commercial performance, sales activity and pipeline development.
• Contribute to the overall business strategy as a member of the management team.

Team Leadership

• Lead, coach and develop a team of 3 sales professionals.
• Foster a high-performance culture focused on customer value and commercial results.
• Support the team in managing complex sales cycles and strategic accounts.
• Ensure effective collaboration across departments.

Key Account Management

• Build and maintain long-term relationships with major national customers.
• Manage executive-level conversations with key decision-makers.
• Lead commercial negotiations and contract discussions.
• Act as a trusted partner for strategic clients and stakeholders.

Marketing Coordination

• Coordinate local marketing initiatives in collaboration with international colleagues.
• Manage relationships with external marketing partners and agencies.
• Support brand visibility, customer engagement and commercial campaigns.
• Contribute to market positioning and business growth initiatives.

What matters most is your ability to lead teams, build commercial strategies and drive business results in a B2B environment.

You bring:

• A proven track record in a B2B commercial leadership role.
• Experience managing and developing sales teams.
• Strong commercial acumen and strategic thinking skills.
• Excellent negotiation and stakeholder management capabilities.
• Experience working with large accounts and complex customer environments.
• The ability to build structure, set priorities and drive execution.
• A hands-on mindset combined with strong leadership qualities.
• Curiosity and the willingness to learn and understand a new industry.
• Fluency in Dutch, French, English

What if the algorithms you build don’t just run in simulation, but actually 
see, understand, and navigate the real world?
 

At M-ECS, you’ll turn perception algorithms into robust, real-time systems that help make off-highway vehicles and other robotic platforms autonomous. You’ll work at the intersection of computer vision, robotics and embedded systems, helping machines understand their surroundings and operate autonomously in demanding industrial and heavy-field environments.
You’ll be part of the team shaping the next generation of autonomous machines, turning bold ideas into technology that works in the field.
 

You’ll see your work move from 
algorithm → machine → real-world impact.
 

YOUR ROLE, YOUR IMPACT.
 

As a hands-on Computer Vision & Perception Engineer, you’ll help build the perception capabilities that enable autonomous machines to operate safely and reliably in demanding real-world environments, from off-highway vehicles to other robotic platforms.
 

Key responsibilities:
 
 

• Developing perception capabilities for object detection, classification, multi-object tracking, depth estimation, and 3D reconstructions. 

• Processing and fusing sensor data from cameras, LiDAR, radar and GNSS/IMU systems to create reliable, real-time machine awareness. 

• Contributing to SLAM and localization systems that help machines understand where they are and where they’re going. 

• Optimizing algorithms for real-time execution on embedded and GPU platforms. 

• Bringing algorithms to life by integrating perception into machine control and navigation systems. 

• Testing and validating your work on real machines together with System Engineers. 

• Debugging and optimizing perception systems during field testing. 

ARE YOU THE ONE?
 

We’re looking for an 
all-round engineer who enjoys solving complex problems that don’t always come with a manual. You’re hands-on, curious and eager to turn ideas into working systems. You’re not afraid to figure things out along the way and shift gears when needed. You thrive in a fast-paced, ambitious tech scale-up, enjoy working as part of a team and take ownership of delivering high-quality results. 
 
 

• A 
 master’s degree in Automation, Robotics, AI, Computer Vision, or a related field. 

• 2–5 years of relevant experience, ideally in industrial automation, robotics or mobile machinery or equivalent hands-on experience. 

• Strong programming skills in 
Python and/or 
C++. 

• Hands-on experience with 
computer vision and deep learning for 
perception, including OpenCV, YOLO, or similar frameworks. 

• Solid understanding of 
sensor fusion, 
3D geometry, and 
coordinate transformations. 

• Knowledge of 
robotics and 
autonomous systems. 

• The ability to debug real-world systems, not just offline datasets. 

• Experience with ROS/ROS2, LiDAR, SLAM, edge platforms such as NVIDIA Jetson, embedded optimization, or dataset pipelines is a plus. 

• Strong communication skills in 
English and 
Dutch.

Are you an experienced Technical Superintendent or maritime engineer with a passion for inland shipping, vessel management, and technical operations? Do you speak German fluently and enjoy working closely with crews and shipyards?
 

This is your opportunity to take a key role in managing a modern inland fleet in the Antwerp region.
 

Your Role as Technical Superintendent
 

As a Technical Superintendent Inland Shipping, you are responsible for the technical performance, maintenance, and reliability of the fleet. You act as the crucial link between crew, suppliers, and management.
 

Key responsibilities:
 
 
 
• Monitor the technical condition and operational performance of vessels 
 
• Plan and coordinate maintenance, repairs, and inspections 
 
• Visit vessels regularly (2–3 times per week) 
 
• Provide technical support to crews and build strong working relationships 
 
• Handle technical incidents and breakdowns (on-call rotation) 
 
• Manage and execute technical projects, refits, and upgrades 
 
• Develop and follow up on preventive maintenance plans (PMS) 
 
• Maintain contact with shipyards, suppliers, and classification societies 
 
• Manage the technical budget and advise on long-term investments 

Your Profile:
 
 
 
• Bachelor’s degree in Maritime Technology, Electromechanics, or Engineering 
 
• Proven experience as a Technical Superintendent / Vessel Manager (preferably inland shipping) 
 
• Fluent in German and English (mandatory requirement) 
 
• Knowledge of ship engines, propulsion systems, and electrical installations 
 
• Experience with PMS systems and technical documentation 
 
• Familiar with classification rules and maritime regulations 
 
• Strong problem-solving skills and a hands-on mentality 
 
• Excellent communicator, able to connect with technical teams and crew 
 
• Flexible and willing to travel frequently

jobs.description:
Are you passionate about delivering outstanding customer service and fluent in multiple languages? As a Customer Advisor in our Liège-based team, you’ll be the first point of contact for customers, ensuring their needs are met with professionalism and efficiency. You’ll interact with international clients through various channels – calls, emails, and chat – providing accurate, friendly, and timely support.

You will support Satellic customers through different communication channels and provide professional, efficient assistance regarding their requests and issues: handling calls, emails, and chats related to the road toll for freight vehicles in Belgium and, in the future, other projects such as Monizze, Arrive, Fain and verification of on-board documents via the CRM system.

Ready to take the next step in your career? If you have strong language skills, a commitment to delivering excellent service, and thrive in a fast-paced, multicultural environment, we want to hear from you. Apply today and become a valued member of our international customer service team in Liège!

• Excellent command of English, both spoken and written

• Successful completion of an English language assessment

• Strong communication and customer service skills

• Good computer literacy and ability to learn new systems

• Ability to work in a fast-paced, multicultural environment

• Fluency in one or more of the following language combinations: Dutch + English, German + English, German + English + French, or German + English + Dutch

• Trilingual candidates are highly valued

• Additional language skills may qualify for a language bonus

• Availability for rotating shifts between 07:00 and 22:00 (potential for homeworking)

Unique Antwerp Maritime is looking for a Crew Planner. You will be working for one of our clients, one of the largest offshore pipeline installation and subsea construction companies, located in Essen.
 

In this role, you will take full responsibility for crew planning within your assigned disciplines. You ensure everything runs smoothly — from long-term workforce planning to last-minute solutions.
 

Your responsibilities include:
 
 
 
• Creating and managing crew schedules for personnel on board our vessels 
 
• Acting as the point of contact for superintendents, captains, and shore-based colleagues 
 
• Collaborating closely with HR, Operations, and the crew members themselves 
 
• Taking into account experience, certifications, and project requirements 
 
• Identifying shortages or surpluses in staffing and contributing to solutions 
 
• Ensuring a fair distribution of experience and opportunities within teams 
 
• Discussing career growth and development opportunities for crew members together with HR 
 

In short: you maintain oversight in a dynamic environment where no two days are the same.

What matters to us? Your curiosity, drive, and enjoyment of what you do. It’s a big plus if you also bring:
 
 

• At least 3 to 5 years of experience in a similar role, such as crew planning or transport planning 

• The ability to stay calm and maintain an overview, even when everything happens at once 

• Clear and friendly communication skills, with a good sense of humor 

• The confidence to make decisions and take responsibility, always with respect and situational awareness 

• Fluency in spoken and written English; knowledge of Dutch is a plus 

• A willingness to travel occasionally, for example to vessels or our office in Delft

jobs.occupation: English-speaking CE truck driver - frozen food transport
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced CE Driver who's living in Belgium and looking for a stable job? Do you hold a valid CE driving licence and code 95? And do you want to work at a reliable transport company where you can drive modern trucks and be home most evenings?

For a leading frozen food transport and logistics company in Oostkamp, we're recruiting a CE truck driver for delivering frozen food products to customers throughout Belgium and its neighbouring countries. Dutch isn't required for this job, so you're free to apply if you only speak English!

Your job

As a CE truck driver, lorry driver, or HGV driver, you will ensure the safe and on-time delivery of frozen food products to supermarkets, distribution centres, and business customers.

Your drives:

• Transport of frozen goods
• National deliveries throughout Belgium, but also to the Netherlands, Luxembourg, France and Germany 
• Up to 15h/day on the road (waiting and resting times included)
• Varying number of stops: between 5 to 15 stops/day
Routes are prepared in advance and your trailer is already loaded, connected, fuelled, and ready to go before departure.

You'll almost never have to sleep in your truck, except for some for very exceptional cases when there's no other possibility.

We're looking for a driver who:

• Has a valid CE driving licence, code 95 and driver card

• Is residing in Belgium and has legal right to work in the country
• Has a good level of English
• Isn't afraid to start early in the morning and to tackle longer routes
• Has their own transport to the company (no public transport nearby   truck cannot be taken home)
Previous experience in frozen food transport, refrigerated transport or distribution transport is an advantage but not required.

 

!! IMPORTANT ELIGIBILITY REQUIREMENTS: please read carefully before applying !!

• You must already be living in Belgium
• You must already have a valid legal right to work in Belgium (EU citizenship or valid work permit)
Candidates who do not meet these requirements will not be considered for the position. We do not provide visa sponsorship, work permits, relocation support or immigration assistance.

As a class CE driver for roll off container trucks, you represent the organization on the road each day. 

You start your shift daily between 04:00 and 07:00 to complete rewarding container transport routes. You are assured of a stable job within a professional team using well-maintained equipment.

Are you the dedicated class CE driver for roll off container trucks we are looking for? Apply now and we will get in touch with you shortly!

Erkenningsnummer VG 458/BUOSAP

• You hold a category CE driver's license with a valid Code 95 and medical certificate.
• You possess a valid driver card.
• Experience with hooklift/skip containers is a plus.
• You speak fluent Dutch or English.
You are responsible for swapping and placing hooklift/skip containers.

You will be a member of our SEM/TEM team. This team is responsible for in-line and out-of-line released electron microscopy inspection.  As a TEM technician you ensure the smooth processing of the various TEM inspections, focusing on the quality of the inspection. 

As SEM/TEM technician you will have the following key responsibilities:

• You are responsible for (semi)-automated and guided TEM inspections.

• You contribute to achieving targets.

• You help with statistical process control (SPC) on TEM tools. 

• Preferable you have a bachelor’s degree or associate degree (2-year program) in science (chemistry, biology, physics) or equal to experience.

• You are a strong planner and you would enjoy working in a fast-paced environment. You certainly know how to multi-task and prioritize assignments.  

• You are a communicative team player with a very good knowledge of both English and Dutch.

Historically recognized as the global benchmark for premium retail equipment and trolley manufacturing, 
Wanzl has successfully evolved into a 
total solutions provider optimizing customer experiences.
 

To support the ambitious course in Belgium and Luxembourg, Wanzl is looking for an entrepreunerial Business Development Manager.  This role is pivotal in driving the new era, turning premium product innovations and digital solutions into sustainable market share.
 

As Business Development Manager, you act as 'co-architect' of the business transformation in BeLux, supporting the General Manager. You combine traditional sales with high-level strategic business development to gain market share with new, digital, and automated solutions. You pioneer new growth areas while further expanding existing strategic partnerships.
 
 

• You further design and implement a sustainable go-to-market strategy to successfully position the renewed Wanzl portfolio in the market. 

• You take responsibility for major, existing key accounts in retail and proactively expand the C-level relationship network within complex Decision Making Units. 

• You actively identify market opportunities for product innovations (such as digital retail and automation solutions) and lead the acquisition process from A to Z, including complex price negotiations. 

• You implement structured and data-driven sales management (CRM, forecasting, and account planning) to achieve commercial performance and strict P&L and margin targets. 

• You work closely with the local sales and operational teams and the international headquarters to guarantee an optimal customer journey and efficient collaboration. 
 

• You hold a university degree and have 10 to 15 years of proven successful B2B sales and business development experience, preferably in retail or other relevant sector. 

• You are accustomed to operating in highly competitive markets and have experience managing complex key accounts. 

• You combine a strong commercial and entrepreneurial mindset with analytical skills and a P&L and margin focus, capable of translating data into concrete actions. 

• You have a proactive hands-on mentality and enjoy taking independent initiative to drive the business forward. 

• You communicate convincingly at various levels and are fluent in Dutch and French (required for the local market), as well as English (communications with HQ and other affiliates). Knowledge of German is a nice plus.

About Tiense Suikerraffinaderij
For nearly 200 years, Tiense Suikerraffinaderij has been producing sugar from local sugar beets, serving both industries and home kitchens. You'll become part of a family of 600 proud sugar makers who stick together, both on and off the factory floor. They operate with a refined blend of tradition and innovation, aiming for minimal environmental impact as nothing from our sugar beets goes to waste. Our mission? To make life sweeter for people worldwide. And we're excited to do it together with you!

Jobomschrijving

Sweet Challenges Await: Join Our Headquarters in Tienen 
Are you ready to make a sweet impact in a dynamic environment, right at the heart of sugar production? As a Business Controller, you act as a business partner to operations, sales and other departments of Tiense Suikerraffinaderij in Belgium. Our business controllers are responsible for the cost and margin analysis of processes related to the development, manufacturing and packaging of sugar products in our different factories. For this specific function, we look for a colleague who likes to focus on improvement of financial reporting tools and business performance dashboards.

Your job as Business Controller 
At Tiense Suikerraffinaderij, we boast an impressive lineup of 6 factories, each specializing in unique sugar processes. Ensuring optimal efficiency and cost effectiveness across all operations is essential to our success. Your main responsibilities are, together with your colleague business controller: 

• You develop automatic and easy-speaking cost analyses and dashboards. 
• You create added value by making recommendations and thus enabling well-founded business decisions. You develop, maintain and follow up on business data (e.g. budgets, forecasts, cost targets, KPI) and monitor cost efficiencies through the whole chain
• You play an active role in the monthly and yearly closings and the regular forecasting process.
• You report to the Director Controlling. You report to and work together with the colleagues of the Südzucker Group. 

It is in our roots. In yours too? 
At Tiense Suikerraffinaderij, we've been making sugar since 1836. The ingredients for success? They're ingrained in our roots:

• Flexibility and curiosity – We continue to invest in better, more sustainable and more efficient ways of working. As we modernise our processes and equipment, your expertise and ideas will help us make the right choices and drive continuous improvement.
• Technology and common sense – You'll work in a technologically advanced manufacturing environment where data, experience and common sense go hand in hand. By gaining insight into manufacturing costs and collaborating with colleagues across departments, you'll help turn insights into practical improvements.
• Solo and as a team – You'll enjoy a high degree of autonomy and the freedom to take ownership of your work. At the same time, you'll be part of a collaborative environment where teams support one another and work together towards shared goals.
You should also possess the following qualifications and experiences:

• Master's Degree (e.g. economics)
• Minimum 5 years of experience in business/operational controlling or in an analyst function
• A strong affinity with IT tools: 
• knowledge of Excel including pivot tables is essential
• experience in creating reports and dashboards with a modern tool set is required 
• knowledge of SAP FiCo / SAP BI is an asset 
• Excellent level of spoken and written Dutch and English; good level of French
• Strong competencies in and interest for business analytics, as well as a good understanding of accounting
• Hands-on, proactive, and solution-oriented approach

What will you have to do?
 

 
• Learn how to prepare our extensive range of chocolates
 
• You’ll learn the recipes so you can perform all tasks independently
 
• You’ll keep your workstation tidy, because that’s how you prefer to work
 
• As a line operator, you’ll set up the machine according to the correct parameters and adjust them as needed.
 
• You inspect the quality of the finished products.
 
• You supply the raw materials and packaging materials to the production line.
 
• Converting machines is also part of your responsibilities, as is cleaning and maintaining the production line. 

Who are you?
 

 
• You have a degree as a chocolatier, baker, or pastry chef OR possess the necessary experience
 
• Recent graduates in the fields of chocolatier, baker, or pastry chef are also welcome
 
• You are able to work in a two-shift system (5:00 AM–1:00 PM / 1:00 PM–9:00 PM)
 
• You adhere to hygiene and safety standards
 
• You have your own transportation
 
• You have a good to very good knowledge of Dutch or English
